translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Anduane Homogohanda wali agalinaga bi mo tara tara lelenego ogo.
Bambaore dindini wali agali heneru ti bi mbiraore laga hene.
Ti ni tagira ibiragohayagi howa yu dindi wiagohayagi hama pialu dindi mini Babilonia anda puwa ogoriani hene.

Ani biruwa tini lala bialu lalu, I̱name abaleore dindi dugu mbera buwa ege timeni helo irani delami̱ya, lene. Ani lowa tigua ogonidagua bialu anda bule ege timeni wabu bila hene. Ege timeni uruni ndibu laga bulene wagaya tararu manda bu ngela dege bini.

Ani ngelowa lalu, Ainde iname anda dewa bu helowa tano timbuni mbira ngelami̱ya. Tano ogoni dombeneni anda timbuni mbira bugimbu bu migi bima iraga howa hari damindini ela helo mbira bimi̱ya. Ani birimayagua iname bibahende dindi tara tarani hama purogo nale holeberamago. Ogoni hondowa wali agali maru karume inanaga mini yaraga helo ani bimi̱ya, lene.
Ani bialu hemiria Anduane Homogo ibu daluwa tigua anda dewa buwa tano ngeleagobi tano ogoni dombeneha anda bima iraga heagobi hendene.

Ani hondowa ibugua lalu, Ai áyu wali agali uruni ti hameigini mbiraore halu bi mbiraore laga karuni howa tano timbuni mbira bu heledago handa nabere. Ani bialu howa ai tinime hame ledadagua bialu mbirale bulene bibahende ngaru biai holobadago.
Ani biyadagoni lehedago iname dalialu puwa wali agali tininaga bi hale nahene lagalaga bilo bi mo tara tara bimi̱ya ma, lene.
Anduane Homogohanda tinaga bi mo tara tara lagalaga bialu dindi tara tarani hama purogo lelene. Ani biya handala tigua tano biago bumaro nabi wahalu purogo lene.

Tano bialu henedagoni mini Babele. Irane Anduane Homogohanda wali agali uruni tinaga bi tara tara lagalaga bialu tinibi dindi bibahendeha hama purogo lalu pelene. Babele mini ogoni inanaga bi lalu Bi Mo Tara Tara Laga.
Seme ibu aguanene henego ogo
Seme ibu aguanene hama ibinidaruni ogodagua hama ibini. Iba li timbuni biago hundiyagola mali kira howa Seme ibunaga mali handari mbira (100) hayagola ibu igini mbira mini Abagasada hene.
Abagasada helowa Seme ibu mali handari duria (500) hama ibalu heagola ibunaga waneigini marubi hene. Ani ho helowa ibuni homene.
Abagasada ibunaga mali pira tebirani duria (35) hayagola ibu igini mbira mini Sela hene.
Sela helowa Abagasada ibu mali handari mariani tebira (403) hama ibalu heagola ibunaga waneigini marubi ha dege bini. Ani ho helowa ibuni homene.
Sela ibunaga mali pira tebira (30) hayagola ibu igini mbira mini Ebe hene.
Ebe helowa Sela ibu mali handari mariani tebira (403) hama ibalu heagola ibunaga waneigini marubi hene. Ani ho helowa ibuni homene.
Ebe ibunaga mali pira tebirani maria (34) hayagola ibu igini mbira mini Pelege hene.
Pelege helowa Ebe ibu mali handari mariani pira tebira (430) hama ibalu heagola ibunaga waneigini marubi ha dege bini. Ani bu helowa ibuni homene.
Pelege ibunaga mali pira tebira (30) hayagola ibu igini mbira mini Leu hene.
Leu helowa Pelege ibu mali handari kirani huniane dira (209) hama ibalu heagola ibunaga waneigini marubi hene. Ani helowa ibuni homene.
Leu ibunaga mali pira tebirani kira (32) hayagola ibu igini mbira mini Serugu hene.
Serugu helowa Leu ibu mali handari kirani huniane karia (207) hama ibalu heagola ibunaga waneigini marubi hadege bini. Ani bu helowa ibuni homene.
Serugu ibunaga mali pira tebira (30) hayagola ibu igini mbira mini Naho hene.
Naho helowa Serugu ibu mali handari kira (200) hama ibalu heagola ibunaga waneigini marubi hene. Ani helowa ibuni homene.
Naho ibunaga mali pira kirani dira (29) hayagola ibu igini mbira mini Tera hene.
Tera helowa Naho ibu mali handari mbirani pira mbirani dira (119) hama ibalu heagola ibunaga waneigini marubi hadege bini. Ani bu helowa ibuni homene.
Tera ibunaga mali pira karia (70) hayagola howa ibu igini tebira henego mbirago mini Abarama mendego Naho tebonego Harana laga biyaru hene.
Tera iginiru henego ogo
Tera ibunaga igini Abarama Naho Harana imaru hene. Harana ibu igini Lode hene.
Harana ibuni dindi Kaladiaha dindi emene mbira Ua winigoria ibu aba Tera nahome wene daliahe helalu ibu ala homene.
Abarama ibugua Sarai dabu biyagola Naho ibugua Harana wane Miliga dabu bini. Harana ibu igini Isagabi hene dege.
Ainde Sarai ibu waneigini mbira taba hanabe naheore berene.

Ani howa Tera ibugua Kaladia dindiha dindi emene mbira Ua winigo ogoni yu wahalu Kenana dindiha pole pene. Ibu heba penedaruni uru. Tera ibugua ibu igini Abaramabi ibu one Saraibi Tera aguane Harana igini Lodebi ti bibahende puwa Harana tanoni pu hene.
Ani pu howa Tera ibu mali handari kirani duria (205) howa tano ogoriani homene.
